principle: No claims of exact Kingshot damage without reproducible in-game calibration

verificationLevels.A: Official game documentation plus empirical confirmation
verificationLevels.B: Independent sources agree and tested against game observations
verificationLevels.C: Community-supported, mathematically consistent, not empirically validated
verificationLevels.D: Speculative or contradictory; excluded from definitive recommendations

sources.caution: State of Survival engine inferred; not independent Kingshot source code proof

conflicts.description: kingshotsim claims chance-based joiner skills do not stack; Kingshot World describes independent rolls per joiner
conflicts.action: Do not assume either rule; test in game or exclude from deterministic optimization

conflicts.description: KingshotSim labels some components confirmed from State of Survival engine; transfer to Kingshot not independently proven
Pet and Master buffs not confirmed whether represented in displayed snapshots or separate multipliers
conflicts.action: Per-effect inclusion flag and sensitivity range

conflicts.description: Published skill progression tables disagree; score bonus distinct from damage

automatedTests.expect: No active modifiers means result equals baseline
Every already-included modifier contributes exactly zero additional bonus
Top four eligible skills selected by level then join order
Never more than four joiner skills
At +25% each, 2+2 = 2.25 and 4+0 = 2.0, conditional on grouping assumption
Reject non-finite inputs, impossible negative capacities and percentage denominators <= 0
Bear points bonus never silently inserted into combat damage
Any unverified multiplier labels result as model not actual damage

requiredForRelease: Tests executed automatically with pass/fail output, not merely documented
At least 3 distinct account-stat profiles and multiple event modes compared to actual in-game observations
Confidence and error bands calculated per scenario
Contradictions resolved or excluded from exact predictions
Production and frozen Command Center unchanged until explicit approval
currentEvidence: Source review and arithmetic examples only; no real in-game calibration samples in this audit
